source.text:
Hey HN! I am Ashish from AutoCua (automatic computer use agent).

I am building super computer use agent. Imagine a computer use that is not limited to computer automation. If the task needs it, it write code, control browser through extension that it loads runtime to use same profile, control iphone, android wirelessly on any OS.

ALL OF THAT WHILE IT'S DOING COMPUTER USE.

Completely open source written in Python + Rust, Under MIT License.

Do check out Repo- https://github.com/ComputerUseAgent/AutoCua

Watch demo of AutoCUA Playing CLASH OF CLAN + CLASH ROYALE on PHONE wirelessly + CHESS while controlling browser too. Video is attached on README.md.

Have a look tell me what you'd throw next at it. i'll be there in the thread all day.

Thanks!!:)
source.title: Show HN: AutoCua, one prompt drives computer, browser, phones, code at same time
